pages.text: Stops slight and moderate bleeding, protects the wound. Minigame — circles with the mouse in the right direction.
Pressure dressing: holds heavy bleeding better than a bandage.

A fresh dressing is unreliable for $(cfg)5$() min: sprinting ($(cfg)1%%$() per second) and jumping ($(cfg)4%%$()) can tear it, new damage — $(cfg)50%%$() chance.$(br2)A dressing cuts infection risk by $(cfg)80%%$(). Remove it with an empty hand in the $(l)H$() panel.
